nodes.label: VisionTransformer
nodes.desc: ViT-B/L: PatchEmbed, cls token, pos embed, then Block stack

nodes.label: Block
nodes.desc: Pre-norm transformer block with optional fairscale activation checkpointing

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.desc: Multi-head self-attention that can register attention maps for Grad-CAM

nodes.label: Mlp
nodes.desc: Two-linear GELU MLP with 4x expansion

nodes.label: interpolate_pos_embed
nodes.desc: Bicubic interpolation of 16x16-grid position embeddings to a new image size

nodes.label: create_vit
nodes.desc: Factory: base (768d, depth 12) or large (1024d, depth 24) VisionTransformer

nodes.label: BertEmbeddings
nodes.desc: Word + absolute position embeddings with LayerNorm and dropout

nodes.label: BertModel
nodes.desc: MED backbone: BERT encoder that accepts encoder_embeds and a mode flag for unimodal vs multimodal

nodes.label: BertEncoder
nodes.desc: Runs BertLayer stack, threading the mode flag through every layer

nodes.label: BertLayer
nodes.desc: Self-attention plus a crossattention sublayer only when mode=='multimodal'

nodes.label: BertAttention
nodes.desc: Self/cross attention wrapper around BertSelfAttention with output projection

nodes.label: BertSelfAttention
nodes.desc: Cross-attention variant projects K/V from encoder_width (vision width, 768/1024)

nodes.label: BertLMHeadModel
nodes.desc: Causal decoder: BertModel backbone + LM head, label smoothing 0.1, HF generate() support

nodes.label: BertLMPredictionHead
nodes.desc: Transform + linear projection to vocab for next-token logits

nodes.label: BLIP_Decoder
nodes.desc: Captioning model: create_vit + BertLMHeadModel, 'a picture of' prompt, LM loss in forward

nodes.label: blip_decoder()
nodes.desc: Constructor that builds BLIP_Decoder and loads a captioning checkpoint

nodes.label: BLIP_Decoder.generate
nodes.desc: Beam search (num_beams) or nucleus sampling decode, strips the prompt prefix

nodes.label: init_tokenizer
nodes.desc: bert-base-uncased tokenizer plus [DEC] bos token and [ENC] special token

nodes.label: load_checkpoint
nodes.desc: Downloads/torch-loads a checkpoint, resizes pos embeds, drops shape-mismatched keys

nodes.label: BLIP_ITM
nodes.desc: Image-text matching: vision_proj/text_proj to 256d plus a 2-class itm_head

nodes.label: blip_itm()
nodes.desc: Constructor for BLIP_ITM with checkpoint loading

nodes.label: BLIP_VQA
nodes.desc: VQA model: 480px ViT, multimodal question encoder, answer-weighted decoder loss

nodes.label: blip_vqa()
nodes.desc: Constructor for BLIP_VQA with checkpoint loading

nodes.label: BLIP_VQA.rank_answer
nodes.desc: Scores top-k candidate answers by summed log-prob instead of free generation

nodes.label: BLIP_Retrieval
nodes.desc: Retrieval model: ITC with idx-aware soft targets, hard-negative ITM, momentum queue

nodes.label: blip_retrieval()
nodes.desc: Constructor for BLIP_Retrieval with checkpoint loading

nodes.label: BLIP_Pretrain
nodes.desc: Pretraining model: DeiT-initialized ViT, bert-base-uncased encoder/decoder, ITC queue, alpha ramp for capfilt

nodes.label: blip_pretrain()
nodes.desc: Constructor that returns a fresh BLIP_Pretrain

nodes.label: tie_encoder_decoder_weights
nodes.desc: Recursively copies text encoder weights into the decoder, skipping attention mismatch

nodes.label: _momentum_update
nodes.desc: EMA update (0.995) of momentum encoders used for stable ITC targets

nodes.label: _dequeue_and_enqueue
nodes.desc: Maintains the 57,600-entry normalized image/text feature queue

nodes.label: train()
nodes.desc: Per-epoch loop: alpha ramp, forward for 3 losses, backward, AdamW step

nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Entry: DDP init, COCO/Karpathy+LAION loader, blip_pretrain build, epoch loop, checkpoint saves

nodes.label: MetricLogger
nodes.desc: SmoothedValue-backed meters with distributed sync and log_every cadence
